title: Analytical Procedures (Uniformity of dosage units/HPLC)[Content uniformity][Sakura Bloom 20 mg]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Uniformity of dosage units/HPLC)[Content uniformity][Sakura Bloom 20 mg].

action.title: Technique
action.description: Analytical procedure principle: ·       Isocratic Reverse Phase HPLC with UV detection at 218 nm

action.title: Column
action.description: C18, 3 µm, 150 X 4.6 mm, or equivalent column

action.title: Mobile phase C
action.description: Mobile phase A + Mobile phase B (55/45) or Phosphate buffer solution + water + acetonitrile (40/33/27)

action.title: Injection volume
action.description: 10 µl of the test and reference solutions, equivalent to about 2.5 µg of Sakuramil drug substance in the reference solution

action.title: Test solution   (for Sakuramil)
action.description: Approximate 0.25 mg Sakuramil/mL of sample in buffer pH 3.0

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximate 0.25 mg of reference standard/mL in buffer pH 3.0.

action.title: Evaluation
action.description: Determine the peak area for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of test solution. Also determine the peak area for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of the reference solution.
